from pathlib import Path
import hashlib
import pytest
from company_wiki.source_catalog.narrative_business_policy import prepare_reading_business_assessment as prep, detect_business_fact
from company_wiki.document_understanding.operating_states.assertion_roles import prepare_source_assertions
from company_wiki.source_catalog.reading_recipe import business_algorithm_hashes

@pytest.mark.parametrize('text',(
 'Our platform supports remarkable ambitions.',
 'Our platform supports promising possibilities.',
 'Our platform supports unfamiliar technical endeavours.',
 'We aim to pursue luminous horizons.',
 'Our platform plans to support remarkable ambitions.',
 '我们的平台计划支持宏伟愿景。',
))
def test_unseen_unproved_goal_never_gains_business_relevance_or_fact(text):
    result=prep(text,{'relations':[]})

def test_independent_finance_units_cannot_borrow_business_sentence():
    from unit.document_understanding_selection.test_reading_production_selection import _document,_unit,_select
    finance=['Revenue was $20 million.','Net income was $3 million.']
    result=_select(_document(*[_unit(s,paragraph=i,kind='html_paragraph') for i,s in enumerate(finance)]))
    assert not result.evidence_spans
    business='Our product portfolio includes recycling systems.'
    for texts in ((business,finance[1]),(finance[1],business)):
        result=_select(_document(*[_unit(s,paragraph=i,kind='html_paragraph') for i,s in enumerate(texts)]))
        assert {s.raw_text for s in result.evidence_spans}=={business}


def test_actual_recipe_binds_common_typing_and_context_helpers(monkeypatch):
    from company_wiki.source_catalog import narrative_business_policy as owner
    target=Path(owner.__file__).resolve();original=Path.read_bytes
    name='company_wiki.source_catalog.narrative_business_policy'
    before={pdf:business_algorithm_hashes(pdf_frontend=pdf) for pdf in (False,True)}
    assert all(mapping[name]==hashlib.sha256(original(target).replace(b'\r\n',b'\n')).hexdigest() for mapping in before.values())
    def changed(path):
        raw=original(path)
        return raw+b'\n# independent common typed-relation owner mutation\n' if path.resolve()==target else raw
    monkeypatch.setattr(Path,'read_bytes',changed)
    assert all(business_algorithm_hashes(pdf_frontend=pdf)[name]!=before[pdf][name] for pdf in (False,True))
